sentences.text: Qingxiusaurus was a large quadrupedal herbivore, sharing these basic traits with other sauropods.
The type species of this dinosaur is Q. youjiangensis, which was formally described by Mo et al. in 2008.
Taxonomically, Qingxiusaurus is a member of the class Saurischia.
It belongs to the parent group Saltasauridae.
The dinosaur is classified specifically within the family Saltasauridae.
This animal lived during the Cenomanian to Maastrichtian stages, between 100.5 and 66 million years ago.
